title: profile list
description: The unnamed location and each profile below profiles/ in the state or cache base.

schema.description: The JSON contract version; fields are only added within it.

name.description: The profile's name; null for the unnamed location, the bases themselves.

state_bytes.description: The size of the files below the state directory; 0 if it does not exist.

cache_bytes.description: The size of the files below the cache directory; 0 if it does not exist.
